name: War Quarter
summary: The War Quarter is the northwestern district of the Undercity, serving as the command post and martial training ground for the Forsaken. Within its echoing stone chambers, the soldiers, priests, and crafters of Lordaeron hone their weapons and shadow magic in defense of their fledgling kingdom. It houses training halls for warriors and priests alongside weapon masters and heavy industry.

sections.title: The Forsaken Garrison
sections.body: Occupying the northwest sector of the subterranean metropolis, the War Quarter stands as the bastion of martial strength for the Forsaken. Beneath its gloomy stone arches, rank-and-file guards and elite champions assemble to drill in armed combat. Unlike traditional barracks of living kingdoms, this military center combines ruthless iron warfare with the chilling rites of shadow, housing an ominous Altar of Darkness where spiritual discipline merges with military ambition.

sections.title: Forge and Steel
sections.body: Beyond housing warrior and priest guilds, the quarter functions as the heart of Undercity's wartime production. The clatter of blades and armor echoes continually against the stone, supported by the district's blacksmiths, smelters, and weapon masters. Here, iron forged deep in the earth is shaped to outfit the forces defending the ruins of Lordaeron from the Scourge and Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the War Quarter?
faq.answer: The War Quarter serves as the military headquarters of the Undercity. It hosts martial training grounds for warriors and priests, along with vital crafting centers for blacksmithing and mining to keep the Forsaken army armed and armored.

faq.q: Why are priests located in the War Quarter?
aliases: why are priests in war quarter
faq.answer: Forsaken priests largely focus on the discipline of the Shadow, using it as a potent weapon alongside their warriors rather than maintaining pastoral sanctuaries. Their presence near the martial forces and the Altar of Darkness reflects how deeply intertwined faith and warfare are in the defense of the Forsaken.

faq.q: What is the Altar of Darkness?
faq.answer: The Altar of Darkness is a focal point of dark spiritual power located within the War Quarter. It is tied to the Forsaken's dark rites and training, anchoring the shadowy magic wielded by their priests and champions.

faq.q: Where is the War Quarter located in the Undercity?
faq.answer: The War Quarter occupies the northwest quadrant of the Undercity's circular layout, northwest of the central Trade Quarter, between the Magic Quarter to the east and the Apothecarium to the south.

angles.text: The War Quarter is your primary haven in the Undercity, offering weapon masters, advanced combat instructors, and heavy armories to prepare you for the brutal frontline battles of Lordaeron.
Housing both training masters and high-heat anvils, the War Quarter is the central hub for smiths hammering out munitions and plate for the Forsaken war effort.
